It started August 8 and ended on December 13. [[Club Deportivo Árabe Unido|Árabe Unido]] were crowned champions of the [[Liga Panameña de Fútbol]] for the fifth time after beating [[Tauro F.C.|Tauro]] 3-2 in the final.
